default_server.description: The default IRC server hostname to connect to on startup.

default_port.description: The default port for the IRC server.

nickname.description: The primary nickname to use on IRC.

real_name.description: The real name displayed in user info.

language.description: Language setting for the KVIrc interface.

auto_connect.description: Whether to automatically connect to the default server.

reconnect_delay.description: Delay in seconds between reconnection attempts.

servers.description: List of IRC servers to connect to. Note: The `default_server` is used for the [General] block, while this list populates the [Server:N] blocks if multiple are desired or for backup servers. Usually, the first entry is primary.

channels.description: List of channels to join. Items are maps with 'name' and optional 'password'.
